_comment: Single source of truth for the fixed anchors in the flat Sprinter resident (port.md section 3.1/3.9). tools/gen_sprinter_layout.py turns this into asm/sprinter/generated/fixed_layout.inc and fixed_layout.h. Regions here are addresses other code has to agree on out-of-band instead of through a linker symbol table: loader trampoline target, IM2 table/stub, stack/canary bounds, and (plan D3) the LOWRAM_* buffers src/spectrum/lowram_map.h's NETCHESSZX_SPRINTER branch points ports/overlays at -- resident C and each overlay .c are separate zcc/z80asm link units, same reason RTC_PRESENT is fixed rather than EXTERNed. crt0/main/render code floats between TRAMPOLINE and CANARY and is bounded by an ASSERT in resident_s1.asm instead.

regions.name: HDR
regions.owner: preload_loader.asm writes it, resident_s1.asm/crt0 reads it
regions.desc: Boot header published by the loader before SetVMod: magic 'SHS1', WIN2 physical page, reserved.

regions.name: TRAMPOLINE
regions.desc: Fixed handoff target the loader JPs to blindly: validates the HDR magic, maps WIN2 from HDR_PAGE2, sets SP=STACK_TOP, initializes the canary, samples BIOS_CMOS_TEST into rtc_present, then JPs to C_IMAGE_ENTRY (plan D1, port.md section 3.10/S5). Tiny and fixed at this address by construction; ASSERTs in trampoline.asm keep it inside the gap before C_IMAGE_ENTRY.

regions.name: C_IMAGE_ENTRY
regions.desc: Fixed entry point of the z88dk-built resident C image (plan D1): trampoline.asm's last instruction is an unconditional JP here. resident_crt0.asm is built with -pragma-define:CRT_ORG_CODE matching this address. The C image occupies C_IMAGE_ENTRY..WIN1_END (budget ~15.5 KiB) and must not overrun into PSP_LANDING at win2_base -- enforced by the splicer's overlap gate, not by this JSON.

regions.name: NET_FRAME_C
regions.desc: S7 (port.md section 3.7): fourth independently zcc-built WIN2 C-blob (nc_ prefix), spliced by make_sprinter_resident.py into the code gap platform_primitives.asm reserves right before OVL_SLOT (its own ASSERT/DS pair pins this boundary at build time). Holds the portable DIRECT wire-framing core: RX ring, line splitter, 3-slot queue, and nc_pump's ng_recv polling glue -- plus, since S8 steps 4/5, game_protocol.c/keepalive_protocol.c/direct_session_protocol.c, relocated here for WIN1 budget relief (Makefile's own comment on SPRINTER_NET_FRAME_C_SRC), and since S8 step 7, net_frame.c's own nc_mqtt_* stream reassembler (mqtt_min.c itself is deliberately NOT linked into this blob yet -- Makefile's own comment on SPRINTER_NET_FRAME_C_SRC has the byte-cost measurement and the reasoning for deferring it to step 8). The gap's START is not a round number -- it is wherever platform_primitives.asm's own content happens to end, which grows as that file does (0x9997 at S7 step 1, 0x9A99 by step 4, 0x9AB6 once buffers.asm gained cold_win3_page, 0x980F once S8 step 1 moved net_gate.asm's ng_buf_* out to LOWRAM_NET_GATE); find it empirically from the sjasmplus 'truncated to length: -N' message and move this addr, never OVL_SLOT. End stays flush with OVL_SLOT's start (now 0xAB00, see that region), no gap. S8 step 6 moved addr down by 0x280 (640 bytes, leaving 49 bytes of margin over platform_primitives.asm's own 0x980F end) and grew size by the same amount, trading WIN2 asm-pool headroom (S8 step 1's relief left ~689 bytes there, unused by anything else) for net_frame_c blob budget -- WIN1's RESTORE chunking (S8 step 6) needed more relief than restore.c/saveload.c alone could buy without it. S8 step 7 grew size twice more from the OTHER end -- see OVL_SLOT's own note -- since the asm-pool-headroom lever above was already spent (only 49 bytes left): +0x200 (512 bytes) first, then +0x100 (256 bytes) more once the nc_mqtt_* reassembler alone (mqtt_min.c deferred) still overran the first grow by 89 bytes.

regions.name: OVL_SLOT
regions.desc: Overlay dispatch slot, top of the WIN2 half (plan D2, moved here from the S3 probe's 0x7800 -- WIN1 addr -- specifically so the z88dk C image gets a contiguous, uninterrupted WIN1 run up to WIN1_END; a WIN2 slot is also never displaced by LIBMAN.l_call's DLL load, which only maps into WIN1). Empty in the static image; the loader copies a packed overlay here at runtime from the asset page via win0_map_di/LDIR/win0_restore under DI (R1). S8 step 7: shrunk from 0x800 (2048) to 0x500 (1280) in two passes -- CONTROL, the only mode-0 overlay ever placed here, is 1082 bytes (198 bytes of margin left after both) -- ceding the freed 768 bytes to NET_FRAME_C, whose own ~4 KiB ceiling had no room for the nc_mqtt_* reassembler otherwise (mqtt_min.c itself stays off this build, see NET_FRAME_C's own note). addr moved from 0xA800 to 0xAA00 then 0xAB00 (end stays flush with LOWRAM_MOVE_LOG's 0xB000, no gap). tools/make_sprinter_assets_page.py's OVERLAY_SLOTS constant is the other half of this size and must be changed in lockstep (port.md's own warning on these two independently-hardcoded constants) -- OVERLAY_SLOTS=5 (was 8) keeps its OVERLAY_SIZE=1280 equal to this region's size exactly. 198 bytes is a tighter margin than step 7's first pass left (454) -- CONTROL has not grown across steps 4-6 and nothing in the remaining S8 plan touches it, but a future change there should re-check tools/gen_sprinter_size_report.py's overlay section before assuming room is still free.

regions.name: PSP_LANDING
regions.owner: preload_loader.asm writes it, unused by resident code
regions.desc: Reserved: the loader LDIRs the DSS-issued PSP here (via WIN1) so AppInfo keeps working once this page is mapped into WIN2 (weather_loader.asm:113-120 pattern). Resident code starts at PSP_LANDING addr+size, not at WIN2_BASE.

regions.name: LOWRAM_MOVE_LOG
regions.desc: Plan D3 Sprinter branch of NETCHESSZX_LOWRAM_MOVE_LOG_* (src/spectrum/lowram_map.h): move-log ring, same byte count as ZX/Next -- only the address differs. Fills the OVL_SLOT..CANARY gap left after D2 moved OVL_SLOT to 0xA800.

regions.name: LOWRAM_CHAT_LOG
regions.desc: NETCHESSZX_LOWRAM_CHAT_LOG_*: chat-log ring.

regions.name: LOWRAM_CLOCK_SAVE
regions.desc: NETCHESSZX_LOWRAM_CLOCK_SAVE_*: saved wall-clock snapshot.

regions.name: LOWRAM_GAME_TIMER_SAVE
regions.desc: NETCHESSZX_LOWRAM_GAME_TIMER_SAVE_*: saved GAME/TURN clock state.

regions.name: LOWRAM_LOCAL_INPUT
regions.desc: NETCHESSZX_LOWRAM_LOCAL_INPUT_*: shared line-edit buffer (INPUT_EDIT(9) overlay + fileui + app).

regions.name: LOWRAM_INPUT_HISTORY
regions.desc: NETCHESSZX_LOWRAM_INPUT_HISTORY_*: chat/command input history.

regions.name: LOWRAM_NOTICE_TEXT
regions.desc: gui.c's notice_text is #define'd as ((char *)NETCHESSZX_LOWRAM_INPUT_HISTORY_END) on every platform, not a named lowram_map.h macro -- it just needs NETCHESSZX_NOTICE_TEXT_SIZE (29 bytes, src/spectrum/ui/layout.h) of free space between LOWRAM_INPUT_HISTORY's end and LOWRAM_STATUS's start (gui.c's own compile-time assert enforces this on every platform). ZX gets that gap for free from its overlapping/hand-packed 48K layout; Sprinter's back-to-back regions do not, so this region reserves it explicitly (S5-finish plan D9 size pass, 2026-08-11) -- 32 bytes rounded up from the 29-byte requirement, not aliased by any other region.

regions.name: LOWRAM_STATUS
regions.desc: NETCHESSZX_LOWRAM_STATUS_*: HUD status text. ZX aliases LAST_IP/MQTT_PRESENCE inside this span to save bytes (48K budget); Sprinter has room, so LOWRAM_LAST_IP and LOWRAM_MQTT_PRESENCE below get their own regions instead of overlapping this one -- same macro names, non-aliased layout.

regions.name: LOWRAM_LAST_IP
regions.desc: NETCHESSZX_LOWRAM_LAST_IP_*: last-seen peer IP text.

regions.name: LOWRAM_MQTT_PRESENCE
regions.desc: NETCHESSZX_LOWRAM_MQTT_PRESENCE_*: MQTT presence-topic scratch.

regions.name: LOWRAM_CHESS_BOARD
regions.desc: NETCHESSZX_LOWRAM_CHESS_BOARD_*: 64-cell display board (BOARD(1) overlay).

regions.name: LOWRAM_RULES_BOARD
regions.desc: NETCHESSZX_LOWRAM_RULES_BOARD_*: 64-cell rules-engine board (RULES(0) overlay).

regions.name: LOWRAM_OVERLAY_CONTEXT
regions.desc: NETCHESSZX_LOWRAM_OVERLAY_CONTEXT_*: fixed-size overlay call context, ABI-contractual size (8 bytes) -- must not change independently of overlay_context.h.

regions.name: LOWRAM_HINTED_ROWS
regions.desc: NETCHESSZX_LOWRAM_HINTED_ROWS_*: legal-move hint bitmap (RULES(0) hints entries).

regions.name: LOWRAM_OVERLAY_SCRATCH
regions.desc: NETCHESSZX_LOWRAM_OVERLAY_SCRATCH_*: scratch shared only by the currently loaded overlay. No NETCHESSZX_LOWRAM_UART_RING equivalent here -- that ZX region reclaims the printer buffer for the serial-transport RX ring (asm/uart/), which Sprinter's uNet DLL transport does not use; add it if/when a Sprinter transport actually needs a fixed RX ring.

regions.name: LOWRAM_RENDER_SHARED
regions.desc: S7 step 4: the handful of one-byte cells that the WIN1 resident C and the WIN3-resident render_core.asm both touch. Offsets, in order: +0 gui.c's spectrum_gui_board_flipped, +1 cursor_row, +2 cursor_col, +3 selected_row, +4 selected_col (5 used, 3 spare). render_core.asm lives in its own WIN3 code page (asm/sprinter/zcc/cold_page_crt0.asm, tools/make_sprinter_cold_page.py) built BEFORE resident_c.bin and mapped in on demand, so neither build can see the other's .map and neither window is addressable from the other while the callee runs -- a fixed low-RAM address, known before either build compiles and always mapped in WIN2, sidesteps both problems at once (same idiom netchesszx_hinted_rows already uses for the sccz80-vs-SDCC __at gap, session.h's own comment on that field). Note these cells have NO static initialiser as a consequence: main.c's boot path seeds cursor_row/cursor_col (e4) and selected_row/selected_col (NO_SQUARE) explicitly. ZX/Next are unaffected (this region and the pointer-macro forms are all NETCHESSZX_SPRINTER-only).

regions.name: LOWRAM_NET_GATE
regions.desc: S8 step 1: the ten ng_buf_* staging buffers (net_gate.asm's own EQUs, host/port/tx/rx/lasterr/info/env/ip/env_host/env_port -- 766 bytes total, tx now NG_TX_CAPACITY=160 to fit an MQTT packet), relocated out of the WIN2 asm code gap right before NET_FRAME_C (S7 left only 19 bytes free there; check_sprinter_net_sections.py already requires ng_* to live in [#8000,#C000), and this address qualifies). Replaces the old LOWRAM_NET reservation, whose description (S7: 'RX byte ring, 3x48 line queue, payload_scratch...') was never actually implemented here -- net_frame.c's nc_* state lives in its own WIN2 C-blob BSS instead, and unet_link.c's state is resident WIN1 BSS; this region had zero real readers before S8 step 1 repurposed it. Fills the LOWRAM_OVERLAY_SCRATCH..CANARY gap left after S5-finish plan D9's size pass, the same way LOWRAM_MOVE_LOG fills the OVL_SLOT..CANARY gap D2 left.

regions.name: LOWRAM_MQTT_STREAM
regions.desc: S8 step 1 reservation, unused until step 7: the MQTT byte-stream accumulator (nc_mqtt_stream[223], mirroring ZX's net.c mqtt_stream[223] -- S8's reassembler adapts mqtt_take_stream_packet's varint-remaining-length/resync/compaction shape). Fixed low-RAM rather than net_frame_c's own BSS because unet_link.c (WIN1) and the future MQTT bring-up code (WIN3 cold page) both need to reach it without a window swap, same reasoning as LOWRAM_RENDER_SHARED.

regions.name: LOWRAM_MQTT_PACKET
regions.desc: S8 step 1 reservation, unused until step 7: one reassembled MQTT packet (160 bytes = SPECTRUM_MQTT_PACKET_MAX, mqtt_min.h), handed to spectrum_mqtt_parse_publish/spectrum_mqtt_type. Separate from LOWRAM_MQTT_STREAM for the same reason link.h's payload_scratch is separate from net_frame's line queue: a packet being parsed by the caller must not be a buffer the reassembler is still writing into.

regions.name: LOWRAM_NET_SPARE
regions.owner: unassigned (S8 step 6 will take restore_b64_pending here)
regions.desc: S8 step 1: remainder of the old LOWRAM_NET span after LOWRAM_NET_GATE/LOWRAM_MQTT_STREAM/LOWRAM_MQTT_PACKET are carved out. End is flush with CANARY's start (0xB900), no gap -- same invariant the old single LOWRAM_NET region held.

regions.name: CANARY
regions.desc: Stack canary word, written once at crt0 start and checked by canary_check (R4).

regions.name: RTC_PRESENT
regions.owner: trampoline.asm writes it once, platform_primitives.asm/rtc_sample and C read it
regions.desc: Whether BIOS_CMOS_TEST found a clock (plan D4). Fixed-address, not file-local storage: trampoline.asm samples it before platform_primitives.asm's own code has run at all, so both files (and the C image, via gen_sprinter_platform_defs.py) reference this address by the same generated EQU rather than one file EXTERNing a symbol the other owns -- sjasmplus assembles trampoline.asm and platform_primitives.asm as two independent --raw jobs, not one linked program. Sits in the STACK_TOP..IM2_STUB_ADDR reserve gap (port.md section 3.1), which was already unused scratch.

regions.name: STACK
regions.desc: Resident stack, must be >= 1024 bytes (R4). STACK_TOP = addr + size = 0xBD80.

regions.name: IM2_STUB
regions.desc: Minimal frame-flag ISR: discriminates SIO RR0 bit 0, sets frame_flag, tail-jumps JP #0038 (R6).

regions.name: IM2_TABLE
regions.desc: 257-byte IM2 vector table, uniformly filled with im2.fill_byte so every vector byte (including the 0xFF/0x100 straddle) resolves to IM2_STUB (R6/R9).
